UFC.rule: Treat each published session as a distinct event; never infer a missing session time.

NFL.rule: Use official/network evidence for kickoff and broadcast; do not infer a network from league alone.

NCAA FB.rule: College football has multiple concurrent games; use event IDs plus team matchup and kickoff to match streams.

MLB.rule: Baseball games can run long; timing alone must not mark a game final.

FIVB Men.rule: Volleyball is set-based; a match may remain live well beyond a generic two-hour window.

FIVB Women.rule: Volleyball is set-based; a match may remain live well beyond a generic two-hour window.
